newsitem.title: UK: Lloyd's chairman wins insurance personality award.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's chairman wins insurance personality award.

text.p: Lloyd's of London chairman David Rowland was made Industry Personality of the Year at a reinsurance industry awards ceremony in London on Thursday night.

The judging panel of the Worldwide Reinsurance Awards said Rowland stood "head and shoulders" above the rest of the field for his work in steering the beleagured insurance market through its complex recovery plan.
One judge said: "He has shown real leadership in a remarkably challenging job."
Lloyd's scored another goal when Equitas, the reinsurance vehicle it has set up to assume insurance liabilities from loss-making years, was voted Company Launch of the Year.

Judges said its future was still uncertain, but the massive reserving work that was undertaken for its inception and its authorisation by the UK's Department of Trade and Industry made it a clear winner.

Zurich based insurance giant Swiss Re was awarded the title Reinsurance Company of the year. The judges pointed to the company's performance and the innovative approach taken by chief executive Lukas Muhlemann, who announced last month he was leaving to become group chief executive of the Credit Suisse bank at the end of the year.
Swiss Re, the second largest reinsurer after Munich Re, recently acquired Britain's largest reinsurance company, Mercantile & General Re for 1.75 billion.

The award for Innovation of the Year went to the California Earthquake Authority (CEA) - a $10.5 billion plan funded by householders, insurers, reinsurers and capital markets to solve the crisis caused when insurers in the state stopped selling houshold insurance because of a legal requirement to include high-risk earthquake cover.
Despite bureaucratic delays, the CEA plan was felt by the judges to be ground-breaking in its concept and likely to be emulated to deal with other high-risk situations.
Other winners in the awards, hosted by trade monthly The Review, were:
Reinsurance Broker of the Year - Willis Faber & Dumas
Professional Service Provider of the Year - Coopers & Lybrand
Analyst/researcher of the year - Risk Management Solutions
Marketing campaign of the year - QBE Europe.
